# The recompiled game as a static library, for gbarecomp's
# packaging/web/build_web.sh (scripts/build-web.sh passes this directory as
# build_web.sh's <project dir>).
#
# It compiles the same generated/game that the native build compiles, instead
# of a second corpus regenerated by gbarecomp's tools/cli.py. build_web.sh
# requires a `gbarecomp_game` target and the -mtail-call flag below; it links
# packaging/web/main.cpp, so no game-owned code reaches the browser yet. That
# needs our own link step (Phase 3).
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(mra_game_lib CXX)

get_filename_component(MRA_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../.." ABSOLUTE)
set(MRA_GENERATED_DIR "${MRA_ROOT}/generated/game"
    CACHE PATH "gba_recompile output to compile")
# build_web.sh passes no -D options through, so scripts/build-web.sh hands a
# non-default output directory over in the environment.
if(DEFINED ENV{MRA_GAME_GENERATED_DIR})
    set(MRA_GENERATED_DIR "$ENV{MRA_GAME_GENERATED_DIR}")
endif()
set(GBARECOMP_ROOT "${MRA_ROOT}/gbarecomp" CACHE PATH "gbarecomp checkout")

file(GLOB MRA_GENERATED_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${MRA_GENERATED_DIR}/*.cpp")
if(NOT MRA_GENERATED_SOURCES)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "No generated code in ${MRA_GENERATED_DIR}. Run scripts/regen.sh.")
endif()

add_library(gbarecomp_game STATIC ${MRA_GENERATED_SOURCES})
set_target_properties(gbarecomp_game PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD 20 CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES)
# Generated code includes only <cstdint>, runtime_arm.h and its own header.
target_include_directories(gbarecomp_game PRIVATE
    "${MRA_GENERATED_DIR}"
    "${GBARECOMP_ROOT}/src/armv4t")
if(EMSCRIPTEN)
    # Guaranteed tail calls: runtime_arm.h refuses to compile without them.
    target_compile_options(gbarecomp_game PRIVATE -mtail-call)
endif()
